name: Plane-Cube Intersection
aliases: Volume from a plane slicing a cube
definition: A geometric computation to determine the volume of the intersection between a plane and a cube, resulting in an inscribed irregular polyhedron with 3 to 6 intersection points.
summary: Plane-Cube Intersection computes the exact volume of the irregular polyhedron formed when a plane slices a cube, distinguishing itself by outputting volume rather than just intersection points.
